title: Lamplit Rooms (stock neutral home interior, SNES register)
_note: Stock NEUTRAL-A everyday house (first use: Pale Vault's Glacier Cottage). 90 BPM 4/4, G major with an E-minor lean, 24 bars: A (8) -> A' (8) -> B (8, E minor / C / D, ends on D to lead home). A conversational bed that never pulls focus: the harp/EP lead (pluck) sings short phrases and leaves the 4th bar of each phrase empty for a sparse flute answer; light strings pad; walking plucked bass (root-third-fifth-approach). Four voices.
